payload.purpose_context: This mission advances Charter follow-ups tidy-up (#6539-#6543) on tidy-charter-6539-followups so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.
payload.purpose_tldr: Close the five #6511 follow-ups: migration repo requirement, a hidden import cycle, LANGUAGES on the seam, interview language write ordering, and a reconcile test.

payload.question: #6539: how should the upgrade runner handle a migration that needs a git repository when run outside one?

payload.final_answer: Declared flag: BaseMigration.requires_git_repository ClassVar; runner checks it before detect() and skips unrecorded; apply()-level NotInsideRepositoryError catch removed so a raise inside apply() is a recorded failed (retries).

payload.question: #6541: should the language catalog go on the frozen seam charter.offering.api now?

payload.final_answer: Expose LANGUAGES only: read-only token list, PUBLIC census disposition, charter facade re-export; family expansion stays internal; corpus case filed against epic #6099.

payload.question: #6542: when should charter interview write the settled languages: to .kittify/config.yaml?

payload.final_answer: Ask first, write with answers: propose and ask up front, hold the settled list, write it in the same step as the interview answers for interactive and non-interactive runs; an aborted or failed interview writes neither.

payload.question: #6539: declaring the flag on shipped migrations changes their content_hash (audit-only drift). How should the flag be declared?

payload.final_answer: Edit + accept drift: declare the ClassVar on each affected migration class, accept the one-time audit-only drift, and record the reason in the PR, changelog and an ADR 2026-10-17-1 note.

payload.question: #6541: LANGUAGES is a tuple of LanguageSpec (families, regexes, rank). What goes on charter.offering.api?

payload.final_answer: Token tuple only: export a derived read-only LANGUAGE_TOKENS tuple[str, ...] declared in the catalog; LanguageSpec, families and regexes stay internal.

payload.wp_title: Language settlement: one-way dependency, write with the answers (#6540, #6542)
